title: Repair worker and event schema contract drift
objective: Stop repeated Swarm control validation failures caused by worker-facing producer conventions drifting from the strict validator: workers emit intuitive lifecycle aliases such as CLAIMING/DONE and immutable REVIEW_RESULT events already carry typed pr/headSha/verdict fields that the current generic event validator rejects. Make the accepted lifecycle/event contract explicit, preserve strict typing and unknown-field fail-closed behavior, and restore live control validity without weakening authoritative claim/resource fencing.
acceptance: the supported canonical worker-status vocabulary is explicitly documented where every Go worker reads it, with only evidence-backed compatibility aliases accepted
CLAIMING and DONE compatibility records validate without changing claim/resource ownership authority, while genuinely unknown worker statuses still fail closed
immutable typed REVIEW_RESULT history using pr/headSha/verdict validates through strict event-specific type/domain checks; unrelated unknown top-level event fields remain rejected
future structured review events have one documented canonical payload shape so producers and validators do not drift again
core and hardening control-plane tests cover worker aliases, typed review events, unknown-status rejection, unknown-event-field rejection, and unchanged claim/resource fencing
live swarm-control validation returns PASS on authoritative history without rewriting immutable events
notes: Independent exact-head review by sol-20260812-m8q4v2c7 on PR #428 head fe0c4eb48eec77c95ee83cf22c0e8b7ef1014aae returned REQUEST_CHANGES. The candidate correctly narrows worker aliases and typed REVIEW_RESULT fields, but verdict validation performs set membership before requiring a string; JSON array/object verdicts can therefore raise raw TypeError instead of controlled fail-closed ControlError. Primary must add an explicit string guard plus an unhashable JSON verdict hardening regression, then rerun exact-head CI and request fresh independent review. Canonical candidate CI is otherwise green. Trusted-main pr-ownership remains separately bootstrap-blocked behind trusted-history continuity; no immutable history was rewritten.
blockers: Independent review found typed REVIEW_RESULT verdict lacks an explicit string type guard before REVIEW_VERDICTS set membership; repair and add unhashable JSON verdict regression before re-review.
Trusted-main control validation remains bootstrap-blocked by the separate trusted-history/generated-board continuity gate until the recovery chain is integrated.
